answer: Beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop bulk fake identities. Each agent is one vertex, posts a 10-unit bond, and sends a heartbeat. A walnut sorter faces the same check. The beacon picks random agents for a puzzle due in ten minutes; a lotus pond's pump missing twice loses its bond. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 machines and 10,000 units in bonds, above one reward, while an honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
